purpose: Teach: 山積み/二日酔い/きもの/スライス/話しかける/掴み/じゃー/鍵盤

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宿題、本気で、絶対、山積みって、聞いたぜ、本気で、絶対、頑張ってね、桜、本気で、絶対、応援
lines.en: Riku, I heard your homework's piled up like crazy. You better actually put in the effort, okay?
lines.style: Rapid, teasing cadence with genuine warmth underneath. Leans forward slightly. The mock-serious delivery of a friend who cares more than she's letting on.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お父さん、本気で、絶対、二日酔いで、絶対、休んでる、絶対、けっこう、絶対、しんどそうだぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. My dad's pretty much knocked out with a hangover. He's looking rough today.
lines.style: Wry, almost amused half-laugh. Casual shoulder drop. Self-aware — not complaining, just stating the obvious situation with a light touch.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お祖母ちゃん、本気で、絶対、きもの、絶対、お正月に、絶対、着るって、絶対、お母さん、絶対、言ってたよ、リク
lines.en: My grandma's going to wear a kimono for New Year's, my mom was saying. That's pretty cool.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Slight smile in the voice. Not emphasising the statement — just remembering something someone said and mentioning it naturally.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 家庭科で、本気で、絶対、パン、絶対、スライス、絶対、上手にできたぞ、桜、お前にも、絶対、見せたい
lines.en: I actually managed to slice bread pretty cleanly in home ec today. I wanted to show you how it turned out.
lines.style: Genuinely pleased, a little shy about it. The careful pacing of someone sharing something they're quietly proud of. Soft invitation at the end, not performative.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 最近、本気で、絶対、新しいクラスメイト、絶対、話しかけるよう、絶対、頑張ってるよ、リク
lines.en: Lately I've been trying harder to talk to the new people in my class. It's not easy but I'm working on it.
lines.style: Earnest, slightly vulnerable. Steady pace — not rushing to explain away the admission. The voice of someone being honest about their effort rather than their success.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試合で、本気で、絶対、勝利を、絶対、掴みたいよな、桜、お互いに、絶対、頑張ろう
lines.en: I really want to win the match. We should both keep pushing, yeah?
lines.style: Firmer resolve here. Direct eye-contact level. The word 'win' lands with weight. Not aggressive — just clear intention, inviting him to match it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃー、リク、本気で、絶対、また、絶対、明日、絶対、学校で、絶対、会おうね
lines.en: See you tomorrow at school, okay?
lines.style: Bright, easy send-off. Quick and warm. The natural lift of someone heading out but already looking forward to the next time.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、ピアノの鍵盤、絶対、上手に、絶対、弾けるんだぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: You're actually really good at piano, you know. I mean it.
lines.style: Genuinely complimentary, slightly surprised at his own sincerity. Slight hesitation before 'I mean it' — checking himself to make sure he's saying it right. Quiet intensity.
